description: This file implements the SecApi class and related classes for handling cryptographic keys and JWT token encoding/decoding, including signature validation and key management.

classes.name: JWTSecApi
classes.description: Class providing JWT token encoding, decoding, and signature validation functionalities, utilizing cryptographic keys managed via SecApi.

classes.name: JWTSecApi::SecApi
classes.description: Handles cryptographic key generation, deletion, and MAC operations.

classes.name: JWTSecApi::MacGenerator
classes.description: Generates HMAC signatures for JWT tokens.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token, appending a signature.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token, verifying its signature.

methods.name: PayloadLength
methods.description: Returns the payload length of a JWT token.

methods.name: ValidSignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a JWT token.
